summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Hartford Multifactor US Equity ETF (ROUS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Hartford Multi-factor Large Cap index. The fund tracks an index of US large-cap stocks. The index relies on value, momentum and quality factors, among others. ROUS was launched on Feb 25, 2015 and is issued by The Hartford.

holdings.infoBox: ROUS is an equity ETF with a total of 330 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 1.47%, Alphabet at 1.20%, Microsoft at 1.19%, NVIDIA at 1.18%, and Cisco Systems at 1.11%.
